lines.text: The songwriter says it is good to praise the LORD with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
The songwriter says the LORD has made him glad by His deeds, and that His thoughts are deep.
Though the wicked sprout like grass, they will be forever destroyed, and all evildoers will be gathered.
The LORD has exalted the songwriter's horn like a wild ox, and his eyes see his enemies' downfall.
The righteous will flourish like a palm tree and grow like a cedar in Sinai, planted in the LORD's house.
